name: 2Hr Aquarist APT Complete
description: Comprehensive macro+micro all-in-one. Manufacturer-disclosed per-dose figures: 5 ml per 100 L adds 4 ppm K, 1.5 ppm N, 0.7 ppm PO4, 0.4 ppm Mg, and 0.03 ppm Fe (plus trace B/Cu/Mn/Mo/Zn). The `no3` value below is the published 1.5 ppm elemental N converted to NO3-equivalent (×4.43 ≈ 6.64 ppm NO3) so the field stays honestly in nitrate units.
notes: Published N is 1.5 ppm elemental nitrogen; stored as 6.64 ppm NO3-equivalent. 10x more potent than conventional ferts — dose by the label, not by eye.
